host_current_build_equivalence.disposition: Host acceptance ran with package-3 staged runtime binaries and matching unstripped Rust fixtures. Final package-5 runtime and privileged/platform test binaries are byte-identical. Only namespace qualification tools and a historical C test fixture changed; host runner sources are unchanged. All final installed namespace checks ran against package 5.

limits: Cross build only; no ARM64 runtime qualification.
Zig linker rejects --fix-cortex-a53-843419; wrapper filters that flag. This is a portability build, not an ARM64 release package.
Only named Fedora44 x86-64 enforcing SELinux deployment and thin one-time SSH/stdio profile qualified.
Untrusted accounts stay in enforcing requester domain, locked nologin, no sudo or alternate entry; all unconfined host accounts are trusted administrators.
Single child userns owning all eight namespaces; no nested/mixed/idmapped topology claim.
Policy change is detect-and-terminate, requiring administrative drain/restart; no atomic replacement interlock.
Sealed ELF does not bind subsequent libraries/scripts.

Namespace full/export/offline and process-PID production targets excluded; other LSM/executable models, managers, PTY, physical FIDO, hooks, reusable grants, reload, remote collector/ACK and external rollback protection deferred.
ARM64 cross build only; wrapper filters unsupported Cortex-A53 linker erratum flag.
